name: holocron
description: Holocron - boveda documental empresarial para proyectos, documentos, RFIs, IA documental y CLM.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:types: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false
